Policy: Code of Conduct Policy (Version V.01, effective 2026-01-01)
Policy ID: code_of_conduct
Section: 1 Purpose
The objective of this policy is to provide and promote general guidance about Pulse Pharmaceutical's expectations on the standards of ethics to be observed while conducting its business. The Code lays down a broad policy for one's conduct in dealing with the Company, Stakeholders, Customers, Vendors, Employees and the External Environment in which the Company operates. The Company believes in conducting its business with responsibility, transparency, honesty, integrity and environment safely including compliances. All the concerned are expected to read and understand the Code and confirm in writing that they will uphold the standards prescribed in this policy and act within the bounds of the authority conferred upon them.

Policy: Code of Conduct Policy (Version V.01, effective 2026-01-01)
Policy ID: code_of_conduct
Section: 2 Scope
This policy is applicable to all employees across all locations of Pulse Pharmaceutical.

Policy: Code of Conduct Policy (Version V.01, effective 2026-01-01)
Policy ID: code_of_conduct
Section: 3 Respect > 3.1 Equal Opportunity Workplace
The Company strives to hire and promote people on the basis of their merit, qualifications, performance, and abilities, without regard to race, color, gender, age, expression, marital status, religion, gender change status, caste, national origin, or medical condition and/or disability unrelated to the ability to perform a job, or on account of membership or non-membership in any protected category under federal, state, or local laws. At Pulse Pharmaceuticals, we believe that diverse workplace will build up competitive advantage.

Policy: Code of Conduct Policy (Version V.01, effective 2026-01-01)
Policy ID: code_of_conduct
Section: 3 Respect > 3.2 Free of discrimination and harassment
Pulse Pharmaceuticals strives to provide a work environment which is free from any kind of discrimination and harassment. As a responsible corporate citizen, Pulse Pharmaceuticals is committed to a gender friendly workplace. It seeks to prevent/ stop/ redress sexual harassment at the workplace and institute good employment practices. We are committed to adhere to the principles as laid down in the Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013 and rules thereunder (SHWW Act). Please refer to the company policy on Prevention of Sexual Harassment (PoSH). We encourage employees to report any harassment concerns and is responsive to employee complaints about harassment or other unwelcome and offensive conduct. The management shall initiate an appropriate action which may include termination of services after investigating the complaints.

Policy: Code of Conduct Policy (Version V.01, effective 2026-01-01)
Policy ID: code_of_conduct
Section: 3 Respect > 3.3 Conduct at Workplace
In dealing with each other, all the employees including directors and senior management shall uphold the values which are at the core of our HR Philosophy - respect to people and company assets, trust, teamwork and collaboration, honesty and integrity. All the employees are expected and required to maintain certain standards of conduct as listed below, during the course of their employment. This list below is not exhaustive, and can include other situations, which may be viewed as critical by the company. Violation of these standards might result in disciplinary action, including among other things - imposition of fines, deduction of salary/leave, suspension from work and immediate dismissal from service.

3.3.1. Insubordination or disregarding directions received from a Superior.

3.3.2. Willful violation of corporate or government rules and regulations as well as any act constituting a criminal offence, whether committed on duty or off duty.

3.3.3. Misuse of employee benefits

Policy: Code of Conduct Policy (Version V.01, effective 2026-01-01)
Policy ID: code_of_conduct
Section: 4 Ethics > 4.1 Child Labour
Pulse Pharmaceuticals shall always engage employees as permitted under the provisions of The Factories Act, 1948 and prevailing Child Labour (Prohibition and Regulation) Act. Pulse Pharmaceuticals will ensure that this clause is applicable to all our key stakeholders including contract staff and labour.

Policy: Code of Conduct Policy (Version V.01, effective 2026-01-01)
Policy ID: code_of_conduct
Section: 4 Ethics > 4.2 Gifts and Entertainment
Pulse Pharmaceuticals and its employees shall neither receive nor offer or make, directly or indirectly, any illegal payments, remuneration, gifts, donations or comparable benefits which are intended to or perceived to obtain business or uncompetitive favors for the conduct of its business. Pulse Pharmaceuticals and its employees may accept nominal gifts (ONLY in kind), like diaries, calendars, sweets and any other articles up to Rs.1000/- which are customarily given and are of a commemorative nature for special events. In case of the nominal value the gift exceeds Rs.1000/-, employees may politely reject the gift. Any other gift, whose value is beyond Rs. 1,000/- in any other form including free travel invitation has to be intimated to HR for appropriate response including ratification and action as necessary.

Policy: Code of Conduct Policy (Version V.01, effective 2026-01-01)
Policy ID: code_of_conduct
Section: 4 Ethics > 4.3 Illegal and abusive practices, bribery and corruption
All the Members of the Board of Directors and Management Team strictly adhere to the ethical standards of business operations, without compromising on all forms and demonstration of corruption at all levels. Pulse Pharmaceuticals follows all the applicable Anti-Corruption Laws under the Indian Statutory Framework including the following:

i. Indian Penal Code, 1860,

ii. Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988,

iii. Prevention of Money Laundering Act, 2002,

iv. Right to Information Act, 2005,

v. Central Vigilance Commission Act,

vi. Lok Ayukta Acts of States, and

Policy: Code of Conduct Policy (Version V.01, effective 2026-01-01)
Policy ID: code_of_conduct
Section: 4 Ethics > 4.3 Illegal and abusive practices, bribery and corruption
vii. Any other Act/statutes as may be notified by the Government of India from time to time. The "corrupt practices" will include - giving or receiving bribes, intermediation in giving or receiving bribes, malpractice, misuse of official authority, commercial bribery, facilitation payments, illegal use of the official position by a person to receive benefits in the form of money, property or other assets, services, and any rights to himself or to other persons or illegal provision of benefits or rights by other persons. In view of the above, all employees of our Company are strictly prohibited, whether directly or indirectly, personally or through the mediation of third parties, to be involved in corrupt activities, offer, give, promise, request and receive payments or make payments to simplify administrative, bureaucratic and other formalities in any form including cash, valuables, services or other benefits to any person or from any persons or organizations, including governments and local authorities, government officials, private companies and its representatives. The illustrative list of acts /practices which are restricted / prohibited is given below: I. Dishonest misappropriation of property/money. II. Criminal breach of trust. III. Cheating. IV. Receiving or giving bribe. V. Charity in order to obtain commercial advantages. VI. Participation/Contribution in/to Political Activities. VII. Payment of any costs for government officers and their relatives (or in their interests) in order to obtain commercial advantages, and VIII. Any other unethical act or omission. IX. To use partners, agents, joint ventures, intermediaries, or other persons for any actions that are contrary to the principles and requirements of the Policy or the rules of the applicable anti-corruption laws.

Policy: Code of Conduct Policy (Version V.01, effective 2026-01-01)
Policy ID: code_of_conduct
Section: 4 Ethics > 4.4 Environment Policies
The Company believes that commitment to sustainable development is a key component of responsible corporate citizenship and therefore deserves to be accorded the highest priority. Accordingly, the Company is committed to Best Practices in environmental matters arising out of its business activities and expects each business to fully demonstrate this commitment. In addition to complying with applicable laws and regulations, Businesses must establish procedures for assessing the environmental effects of their present and future activities. They should adopt Best Practices in their environmental policies and procedures.

Policy: Code of Conduct Policy (Version V.01, effective 2026-01-01)
Policy ID: code_of_conduct
Section: 4 Ethics > 4.5 Statutory Compliance
Pulse Pharmaceuticals will comply to all the statutory and legal requirements as applicable to the place in which it is operating. Every employee of Pulse Pharmaceuticals shall, in his or her business conduct, scrupulously comply with relevant legislations which are of concern personally and professionally. Disclose in advance, to the corporate management, represented by the Chief Executive Officer of the company any favorable interpretation not in consonance with the spirit of law.

Policy: Code of Conduct Policy (Version V.01, effective 2026-01-01)
Policy ID: code_of_conduct
Section: 4 Ethics > 4.6 Conflict of Interests
Employees shall avoid any activity that creates a conflict between their personal interests and the company's business interests without written consent of the management for anything that could be perceived as a conflict. Examples include i. Taking up part-time assignments which involve receipt of honoraria/fees/other compensations. ii. Commitment to causes that may involve spending large amounts of time and energy, which would jeopardize the efficiency at the workplace. iii. Taking up part-time courses which will involve attending classes regularly without seeking prior approval from the Management. iv. Working directly, supervise or make employment decisions about family member. Please reach out to your Manager and HR in case of any queries related to this. HR will be responsible for determining if the acknowledged relationship is covered by the policy. v. Conducting Company business with a relative or with a business where the relative is in a significant role. Family includes spouse, father, mother, children, siblings, grandparents, in-laws. Any such dealings knowingly or unknowingly should be brought to the notice of the Management in writing.

Policy: Code of Conduct Policy (Version V.01, effective 2026-01-01)
Policy ID: code_of_conduct
Section: 4 Ethics > 4.7 Fair dealings
Employees shall not utilize the services of any supplier/customer/vendor towards individual interests, unless the service is being paid for and the same is also disclosed to the management. Highest levels of honesty, integrity and confidentiality should be maintained in all business dealings with customers, suppliers, fellow-colleagues and other stakeholders.

Policy: Code of Conduct Policy (Version V.01, effective 2026-01-01)
Policy ID: code_of_conduct
Section: 5 Protecting Company Assets > 5.1 Confidentiality
5.1.1. Confidential information is the Key Asset for Pulse Pharmaceuticals. The directors, officers and employees shall maintain the Confidentiality of information of the Company or that of any customer, supplier or business associate of the Company to which Company has a duty to maintain confidential, except when disclosure is authorized or legally mandated. The Confidential information includes all non-public information (including private, proprietary, and other) that might be of use to competitors or harmful to the Company or its associates. The use of confidential information for his / her own advantage or profit is also prohibited.

5.1.2. The Salary, remuneration components of CTC (Cost to the Company), rewards any other monetary benefits are strictly confidential between the organization and the individual employee. Disclosing or discussing personal or colleague's remuneration is strictly prohibited. Anyone found violating the above shall be subject to disciplinary action.

5.1.3. Misappropriation or unauthorized disclosure of Pulse Pharmaceuticals assets and confidential information is a breach of this code.

5.1.4. All the employees including the directors of the Company are required to sign a non-disclosure agreement form on the day of joining which details about their confidentiality obligations with Pulse Pharmaceuticals. Refer Annexure- 1 for Non - Disclosure Agreement

Policy: Code of Conduct Policy (Version V.01, effective 2026-01-01)
Policy ID: code_of_conduct
Section: 5 Protecting Company Assets > 5.2 Providing Information to Media and Social Networking Sites
To ensure that only accurate information is provided to the media and on the social network, company has designated Business Development team to handle all the communications outside the company. Additionally, Chief Executive Officer, Chief Operating Officer and Chief Financial Officer are official company spokesperson on all financial matters.

Policy: Code of Conduct Policy (Version V.01, effective 2026-01-01)
Policy ID: code_of_conduct
Section: 5 Protecting Company Assets > 5.3 Company Assets
No employee including directors of the Company shall misuse Company's assets for individual profits, unlawful or unauthorized use or unethical use. In the use of Company facilities, care shall be exercised to ensure that costs are reasonable and there is no wastage. Company assets include - information, data, technology, intellectual property, patents, copyrights, trademarks, facilities, furniture, machinery, software, hardware, printers, books, stationery and all other office items. All the assets shall be used discretionarily for business purpose only.

Policy: Code of Conduct Policy (Version V.01, effective 2026-01-01)
Policy ID: code_of_conduct
Section: 6 Non-Adherence
Any instance of non-adherence to the Code of Conduct / any other observed unethical behavior on the part of those covered under this Code should be brought to the attention of the immediate reporting authority, who shall in turn report the same to the Head of Corporate Human Resources.

Policy: Code of Conduct Policy (Version V.01, effective 2026-01-01)
Policy ID: code_of_conduct
Section: 7 Declaration By Employee
It mandatory for every employee of Pulse to read and understand the Code of Conduct and Ethics Policy and thereafter sign a declaration of their compliance with policy guidelines. It is the responsibility of the concerned HR that every new joinee as a part of the onboarding process signs the declaration after reading and understanding the policy.
